scope: Classification of filename candidates in the exact pinned third_party/rust source archive, compared with the previously derived V8 Temporal GN crate-target closure.
method: Every extracted license-like candidate path and SHA-256 was checked against the exact archive and the preserved local copy. chromium_crates_io/vendor directory names were compared with vendorDirectory values in deno-v8-rust-runtime-reachability.json.
temporalClosureEvidence: All 46 crate directories in the Temporal target closure have candidate license files; their 68 full license texts are already enumerated in deno-v8-rust-runtime-reachability.json and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

nonVendorCandidates.classification: Patch file whose filename mentions re-adding the Apache license for patch generation; not a vendor license text file.

limitation: The remaining candidates have been compared against the full pinned V8 GN/GNI source: 352 vendor license candidates are outside the declared source-build runtime Rust target closure; one non-vendor candidate is a patch containing Apache license text for patch generation. Rusty V8 CI builds and publishes source-built static archives, but the exact archive digest selected for the packaged Deno executable is not recorded; this source closure is not a binary-level link map.

runtimeTargetEvidence.finding: group("v8_maybe_temporal") depends on //third_party/rust/temporal_capi when v8_enable_temporal_support is true.
Rust, Rust CXX, and V8 Temporal support are enabled in this pinned source configuration.
Pinned Rusty V8 CI sets V8_FROM_SOURCE=true for matrix builds.

nonRuntimeReferences.finding: The temporal_capi dependency is in v8_debug_helper_internal, which is marked testonly=true.
third_party/rust appears in a testonly data-input list for gcmole analysis, not as a compile/link dependency.

pinnedV8GnReferenceAudit.assessment: The pinned GN source contains only the Temporal Rust crate target as a non-test runtime dependency. The previously derived 46-target/120-edge closure and its 68 license texts therefore cover the source-build runtime Rust target path; the other 352 vendor license candidates are outside that runtime path.
pinnedV8GnReferenceAudit.limitation: The source GN closure is well supported for the pinned Rusty V8 source-build/release pipeline, and ordinary crate builds fetch a versioned prebuilt archive. The exact archive asset digest and build invocation used for the bundled Deno executable are not recorded, so this remains source-target evidence rather than a binary-level link map or executable SBOM.

prebuiltArchiveFlowEvidence.source: rusty_v8/build.rs:102-124 in the exact crate source
prebuiltArchiveFlowEvidence.finding: When V8_FROM_SOURCE is unset, the crate downloads a prebuilt static archive; setting it builds V8 from source.

prebuiltArchiveFlowEvidence.source: rusty_v8/.github/workflows/ci.yml:262-263 and 487-507 in the exact crate source
prebuiltArchiveFlowEvidence.finding: The pinned upstream CI sets V8_FROM_SOURCE=true, packages the resulting static library, and publishes it on tagged releases.
